prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: mypy 2>&1 | tail -40; cat pyproject.toml; git ls-files
cd src/trailhead && cat -n elevation.py pace.py report.py track.py; cat ../../README.md; grep -rn "None\|ele" ../../tests | head -60; git log --oneline | head

cd ../.. && mypy; ruff check; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
mkdir -p tmp_chk && printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n' > tmp_chk/n.csv
python - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"src")
from trailhead.track import parse_track
from trailhead.report import summarise
from trailhead.plan import split_days
from trailhead.cli import main
t = parse_track("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,160\n")
print(t.elevations(), summarise(t), split_days(t))
print("rc", main(["summary", "tmp_chk/n.csv"]))
EOF
rm -r tmp_chk

cd ../.. && mypy; ruff check; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
python - <<'EOF'
import sys, tempfile, os; sys.path.insert(0,"src")
from trailhead.track import parse_track
from trailhead.report import summarise
from trailhead.plan import split_days
from trailhead.cli import main
t = parse_track("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,160\n")
print(t.elevations(), summarise(t), split_days(t))
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); p = os.path.join(d, "n.csv")
open(p, "w").write("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n")
print("rc", main(["summary", p]))
EOF
